name: An Ambassador of Evil
summary: Historian Karnik wants Ambassador Infernus of Angor Fortress put down. You are to go back into the Badlands, and carry proof of the kill to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.

sections.title: The Ambassador in Angor Fortress
sections.body: Ragnaros himself sent Ambassador Infernus to Angor Fortress to oversee the Shadowforge as they hunt for lost artifacts in Uldaman. The toll in dwarven lives has already been heavy and is worsening. Karnik dares not guess how many artifacts the Shadowforge might find and use against Ironforge. You are to go back to the Badlands, destroy Infernus, and bring Belgrum proof of your victory. Time presses, since Ragnaros will not wait for them to prepare.

sections.title: Belgrum's Thanks
sections.body: Belgrum praises your dedication to Ironforge and the dwarven people, and will send word of your success to Karnik. Help will also be sent to the Badlands to retake the excavation site. Belgrum has one thing more to ask of you, in King Bronzebeard's name.

faq.answer: Ragnaros himself sent Infernus to Angor Fortress to oversee the Shadowforge as they hunt for lost artifacts in Uldaman.
In Angor Fortress, in the Badlands.

faq.q: Why does Karnik want Ambassador Infernus destroyed?
aliases: what is infernus doing in uldaman
faq.answer: The Shadowforge's search in Uldaman has already cost many dwarven lives, and Karnik fears the artifacts they find could be used against Ironforge.

faq.q: Who gives and ends this quest?
aliases: who starts an ambassador of evil
who turns in ambassador of evil
faq.answer: Historian Karnik in Ironforge gives it, and you bring proof of victory to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.

aliases: what do i need from infernus
faq.answer: Ambassador Infernus' Bracer, shown to Advisor Belgrum as proof of your victory.
